exposure: early serum alkaline phosphatase (ALP) levels at 48h
cohort: The study included 437 very low birth weight preterm infants admitted to the NICU at Meir Medical Center from 2014 to 2022.
finding: Early serum ALP levels were linked to neonatal comorbidities but were not reliable predictors of time to full enteral feeding in very low birth weight preterm infants.
